# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 40 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Eve's Lament; Seth Comforts Her

---

**40:1** And Eve fell on her face and wept before the gate of paradise, saying: 'O God, forgive me, for I have brought great sorrow upon all my children.'

**40:2** And Seth came to Eve and comforted her and said: 'Mother, weep not, for God is merciful to all who repent.'

**40:3** And Eve said: 'O Seth, my son, who will comfort me in my old age, for I am alone?'

**40:4** And Seth said: 'God will comfort you, mother, as he has comforted all who have called upon him.'

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
